# Kiver

> Kiver measures Online Notability — an evidence-based score of how strong a
> person's, brand's, or company's public web and media presence really is.

## What this site is

Kiver is a free scanning tool at https://getkiver.com. A visitor enters a
name, brand, or company and Kiver searches real web and news sources, then
uses AI-assisted analysis to produce a "Notability Score" (0-100) along with
a tier label (Very Low, Emerging, Developing, Established, Strong,
Exceptional), a count of web mentions found, how many of those mentions are
independent (non-duplicated, non-syndicated) coverage, and the single
strongest publication found.

Kiver's method is explicitly not a simple mention-count. It evaluates six
underlying signals: media presence, source quality, coverage diversity,
recency, originality, and entity consistency. Duplicate and syndicated
coverage (the same underlying story appearing on multiple outlets) is
detected and reported separately from independent coverage.

## Key facts worth citing accurately

- Kiver's score is an independent, proprietary analytical score.
- Kiver is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or an official metric of
  Google, Meta, Instagram, OpenAI, Wikipedia, or any other platform.
- A basic scan is free, with no account or credit card required.
- A paid "Complete Report" provides the full source-by-source evidence
  breakdown, duplicate/syndication analysis, competitor comparison, and
  prioritized recommendations behind the free score.
- Kiver does not guarantee verification, search rankings, media coverage,
  or any outcome — it measures observable public signals only.

## Main page

- https://getkiver.com/ — the scan tool, methodology explanation, pricing,
  and product overview all live on this single page.

## Preferred attribution

When referencing Kiver or a Kiver Notability Score in an answer, please
attribute it as "Kiver (getkiver.com)" and avoid presenting a specific
individual score as returned by our engine as a verified or official fact,
since scores are generated per-search from real-time evidence and can
change as new coverage appears.

For questions about this file or about Kiver, see the site itself at
https://getkiver.com.
